nodes.description: Owner address of the Ownable contract, set in constructor and changed by transferOwnership.
Total token supply, increased in supply and decreased in burn.
Mapping of holder balances updated in supply, transferFrom and burn.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances.
Per-holder nonce mapping consumed by permit for signature replay protection.
EIP712 domain separator computed in the YFWORLD constructor.
Constant EIP712 typehash for the permit structure.
Constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that transfers ownership to newOwner.
Internal safe-add helper with overflow require.
Internal safe-sub helper with underflow require.
Constructor that builds the EIP712 DOMAIN_SEPARATOR.
onlyOwner mint function increasing balances and totalSupply.
External transfer that delegates to transferFrom with msg.sender.
Public transfer moving balances and reducing allowance.
Burns tokens from an account reducing balance and totalSupply.
Sets an allowance for a spender from msg.sender.
Sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract via an external call.
Callback entry point invoked on the spender contract during approveAndCall.
EIP2612-style signature approval using ecrecover, nonce and expiry.
Caller-controlled address used throughout for auth checks and balances.
Block timestamp (now) used to validate permit expiry.
Untrusted external call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval allowing reentrancy.
Signature recovery in permit that authorizes allowances.
Arithmetic mutation of balances/allowances through sub and add.
Post-increment of nonces[holder] during permit validation.
Parameter of transferOwnership receiving the new owner address.
Recipient parameter of supply and transferFrom.
Amount parameter used by supply, transferFrom, burn, approve and approveAndCall.
Source account parameter of transferFrom and burn.
Spender parameter of approve, approveAndCall and permit.
Holder parameter of permit whose signature is verified.
Nonce parameter of permit validated against the nonces mapping.
Expiry parameter of permit compared with block.timestamp.
Calldata parameter forwarded to receiveApproval by approveAndCall.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
Ownable constructor writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before transferOwnership.
transferOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
newOwner parameter is written into owner.
supply is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier using msg.sender.
to parameter receives minted balanceOf.
amount parameter added to balance and totalSupply.
supply updates balanceOf through the add helper.
supply updates totalSupply through the add helper.
add helper performs the supply balance arithmetic.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom.
transfer passes msg.sender as the from address.
transferFrom checks msg.sender against allowance[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom reads and reduces the allowance mapping.
from parameter selects the debited balance and allowance entry.
amount parameter drives balance and allowance subtraction.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf of from and to.
sub helper performs transferFrom balance and allowance arithmetic.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance back.
burn checks msg.sender against allowance[from][msg.sender].
from parameter selects the burned account.
amount parameter drives the burn arithmetic.
burn reduces balanceOf[from].
burn reduces totalSupply.
burn reduces allowance when the caller is not the holder.
spender parameter is the allowance key granted by approve.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][spender].
spender parameter is approved and then called in approveAndCall.
amount parameter is approved before the external call.
data parameter is forwarded to the spender contract.
approveAndCall writes allowance[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall performs an external call to the untrusted spender contract.
The external call executes receiveApproval on the untrusted spender contract.
Control returns to approveAndCall after the external call completes.
holder parameter is the signer recovered from the permit signature.
spender parameter receives the allowance granted by permit.
nonce parameter is validated against the nonces mapping.
expiry parameter is compared against block.timestamp.
permit depends on block.timestamp for its expiry comparison.
permit reads nonces[holder] to prevent replay.
permit post-increments nonces[holder] after validation.
ecrecover result is used to authorize the permit allowance.
DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is part of the signed permit digest.
PERMIT_TYPEHASH is part of the signed permit digest.
permit writes allowance[holder][spender] without a direct caller check.
YFWORLD constructor computes and stores DOMAIN_SEPARATOR.
amount parameter sets the approved value in approve.
Balance arithmetic via sub/add mutates the balanceOf mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only read to overwrite the owner state variable inside transferOwnership.
to is only used to select the credited balance entry in the supply function.
amount is a pure value parameter consumed by transferFrom arithmetic on balances.
from is only used to index balanceOf and allowance in transferFrom.
spender is only used as the allowance key written by approve.
holder is only used in permit for signature and allowance validation.
nonce is only compared against the nonces mapping inside permit.
expiry is only compared against block.timestamp inside permit.
data is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.
